summary: Tarps that read as canvas pulled over boxes or draped over a loose load, dark buckles on stowed kit and harnesses, finely perforated engine decks on NATO tanks, shaded floors under truck tilts, salted cab panels, painted M35 wheels and cheaper spares.
rationale: Cloth shape, small material swaps and a deck pattern across several families: one matched studio sheet shows each, framed close where the change is small.
